messages:
liam (Support): Escalating: several EU trials not receiving welcome emails after a recent SMTP provider switchover. Affected tenants: Solstice and CedarPay. They can't complete activation, so onboarding is blocked.

maya (CS): Acknowledged. Are they able to sign in at all or completely blocked?

liam (Support): They can reach the site but the verification step never completes because emails never arrive. We see SMTP 550 / relay denied in the outbound logs starting at 09:10 UTC.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-3245 and attached deploy diff + logs.

nate (CS Manager): Maya, please lead customer comms. Olivia, flag any renewal-risk accounts.

maya (CS): On it. What's our immediate stopgap? Can Support flip activation manually?

liam (Support): Yes, we have an admin action to mark accounts active. We'll only do that after explicit customer consent.

olivia (AE): If activation is delayed beyond 48-72 hours, mark renewal risk and offer compensation. I'll prep outreach language for the affected accounts.

sara (Enablement): Workaround documented in staging: enable allow_unverified_smtp and requeue welcome emails. Example command: 

curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/requeue-welcome" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT_ID>"}'

This avoids touching provider config; ops must monitor bounce rates if used.

liam (Support): We'll test the workaround on a dev tenant and report back. If green, we'll apply to affected tenants in controlled batches.

ops-bot: INFR-3245 status: workaround approved for emergency use.

nate (CS Manager): Comms checklist:
- Maya: send the customer note within 30 minutes.
- Olivia: AE follow-up, apply renewal flags as needed.
- Support: only manual activation with consent.
- Ops: deploy workaround, monitor bounces, revert after fix.

maya (CS): Draft customer message below (will send after review):

---
Hi <Name>,
We found an issue causing our welcome email to fail to deliver. We can either:
1) Manually activate your account now so you can get started immediately, or
2) Retry sending the verification email once delivery is fixed.
Please reply with which you prefer and we'll act right away. Sorry for the interruption.
Best,
Maya, Customer Success (Redwood)
---

olivia (AE): Suggest adding: "We'd be happy to schedule a 20-minute onboarding call and provide a one-month credit for the inconvenience if you'd like."

maya (CS): Good call. I'll include that as an option for trial customers.

liam (Support): Update: Solstice opted for manual activation + onboarding call. CedarPay asked we retry the email first.

liam (Support): Per Solstice consent, we've set active=true and scheduled a 30-min onboarding for tomorrow.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert created: email-bounce-rate-eu-west-1 > 0.8%. Paging eng-email channel if not resolved in 15m.

sara (Enablement): I've updated the CS playbook with the emergency workaround and suggested AE credit guidelines. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/cs/playbooks/email-activation-failures

nate (CS Manager): Good response team. Keep posting raw customer replies here. We'll run a short retro after resolution and tighten our onboarding SLA for email delivery. :thumbsup:
